text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At a social gathering where athletes assembled,
Duramente was chosen to deliver a speech
as the representative of her clan.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed.
However, there is no need to worry."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Together with this racing attire, I will take on the challenge.
...Because I've poured that much passion into it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente murmured while touching her racewear.
...It was back when the URA had requested
her to submit her racewear design—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...Finally, my Racewear is here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: If something's troubling you, I want you to talk to me about it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...What runs through this blood is the 'strongest'.
This racing outfit shall be its symbol."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Slipping your arms through the sleeves of racewear...
means wrapping yourself in that heavy responsibility, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given her tendency to get nervous under the duty
of proving herself "the strongest"...
It is only natural for her to feel the pressure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, a racing outfit shouldn't just be a source of pressure.
Is there any advice I can give to ease her nerves...?"
choice_data_list: Want to try referencing other outfits?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Someone else's?
choice_data_list: Maybe we can learn what racing outfits are all about.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. I will follow your suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I brought Duramente to her family's hall of fame museum, adorned with racing silks and championship trophies.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! This place is...
choice_data_list: I thought you could gain a lot from being here.
I thought you could gain a lot from being here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente stopped in front of a display
featuring uniforms from ball games, track and field, combat sports, and more.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This is Dad's.
And Grandfather's uniform is here too...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...It's magnificent. So my family was wearing
these uniforms... when they etched their names
into sports history."

text_block_list.name: Clan Fan
text_block_list.text:
Wah! This world tournament baseball uniform
is from way before I was born!
Seriously, what a legendary family line...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. What is displayed here is
the very proud history of our family."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Then... perhaps the feelings of my clan that I never knew about are—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Trainer. You brought me here to learn what a racing outfit truly is... didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I want to know. To the people of the clan...
what did these uniforms here
truly mean to them?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...! What's displayed next to it is...
Comments on the uniform?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
""What is on display here is a beautifully kept uniform, but...
there is no telling how many times it has been stained with mud and sweat.""

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Even if that stain cannot be seen right now, it is something that will never truly fade."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I will wear this uniform that walked alongside me to glory
with the utmost pride—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It wasn't just this person. The other comments were filled with tales of hardship and effort as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I see. What is displayed here
is not merely glorious "records."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
They were "comrades"—
who overcame hardships together.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —And I engraved it into these racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Like pitch black, a strength that dyes to no one's color.
Like crimson ornaments,
the pride of the blood flowing through this body.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That day, I made up my mind
to don this comrade-in-arms and fight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if her faint trembling earlier had been an illusion,
Duramente stood firm and resolute.
choice_data_list: Looks like you're all good now!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me.
Even as a representative of my family—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Together with this racing attire, I will definitely overcome it.
choice_data_list: Let's leave our hoofprints together in that racing outfit!
I'm glad your nerves are gone.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Befitting the "strongest,"
I'll overpower any opponent.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After that, she stood proudly on the podium
and delivered a magnificent speech.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I must thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: She helped me realize... something I had been overlooking all this time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You're an exceptional Trainer.
